projects.description: A random quote generator that shows a new quote from a collection of favorite video game lines each time the button is clicked. The quote also refreshes on its own every few seconds, and the page changes to a new random background color with every quote.
image_alts: A quote by Patrick McKenzie on a green background, with the Show another quote button
The page after a refresh, showing a Final Fantasy VI quote on a new background color

projects.description: A student directory that splits 42 students into pages of nine, with the list and the pagination buttons built entirely with JavaScript. A search bar filters the list as you type and shows a message when nothing matches.
image_alts: The first page of the student directory, showing student cards with photos, names, emails and join dates
The second page of the student directory with a different set of students

projects.description: A registration form that responds to what the user picks, showing and hiding fields as needed and validating each entry in real time, with clear error messages.
image_alts: The registration form with basic info, t-shirt options and activity checkboxes filled in
The bottom of the form showing the activity total, the Bitcoin payment option and the Register button

projects.description: An object-oriented word-guessing game. Players pick letters on an on-screen keyboard to reveal a hidden phrase before they run out of lives, and the board resets for a new game. The game logic is split between a Game class and a Phrase class.
image_alts: The Phrase Hunter start screen with the Start Game button
A game in progress, with most letters of the phrase revealed, used keys highlighted and two lives lost

projects.description: An employee directory built with data from the Random User API. A single request loads 12 people as cards, and clicking a card opens a modal window with that person's full contact details.
image_alts: The employee directory showing twelve employee cards with photos, names, emails and locations
An open modal with the full details for one employee, including phone, address and birthday
